subject: Operations
title: Deepwater Horizon Explosion
description: A short lesson to help you apply Deepwater Horizon Explosion.

hook.text: An oil rig explodes, killing 11 and spilling 4.9 million barrels into the Gulf. Operations failed at every level.

buildup.text: BP's Deepwater Horizon faced schedule pressure and cost overruns. Shortcuts were taken on safety tests and cement seals.

discovery.text: A cement barrier failed, gas surged up the well, and the blowout preventer—the last line of defense—didn't activate.

twist.text: Multiple warning signs were ignored in the hours before the explosion. Pressure test results were misread.

climax.text: The spill took 87 days to stop. BP paid $65 billion in cleanup, fines, and settlements. The Gulf suffered for years.

punchline.text: Ignoring warnings on the front line costs billions and lives.

quiz.question: What was the last line of defense that failed at Deepwater Horizon?
